test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Pixar’s feature-length releases, which consistently achieved ______ commercial success, were lauded not only for their visual innovations but for their intelligent and emotional storytelling.
solution:
The correct answer is: **worldwide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"worldwide"** means extending or reaching throughout the world. (विश्वव्यापी)
 
• **​"Worldwide"** refers to something that is global, affecting or involving the entire world.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie achieved **worldwide **fame, being recognized and appreciated across different cultures and continents.
 
 
 
• The term "**worldwide**" accurately reflects the global success of Pixar's feature-length releases.
 
• "**Worldwide**" leaves no ambiguity about the extent of Pixar's success, making it clear that it spans globally.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aggregate** (कुल): Formed by the collection of units or particles into a body, mass, or amount.

 
 
• **Example:** The **aggregate **score of the team over the season was very impressive.
 
 
 
• **Planetary** (ग्रह संबंधी): Relating to planets or the motion of planets.
 
 
• **Example:** Scientists study **planetary **movements to understand more about our solar system.
 
 
 
• **Worldly** (सांसारिक): Relating to or concerned with material values or ordinary life rather than a spiritual existence.
 
 
• **Example:** He was more interested in **worldly **pleasures than in spiritual enlightenment.
